node: Franchise procurement, sourcing, and supply-chain orchestration
summary: This Layer 1B pass maps the franchise supply-chain orchestration node to public companies that own or depend on foodservice distribution, sourcing, ordering, product availability, quality control, and restaurant operator support. The reference anchor is Sysco, because recent evidence shows emerging franchise brands using Sysco as national distribution infrastructure. The underfollowed lane points to Performance Food Group and Chefs' Warehouse as less obvious distribution platforms with restaurant-facing procurement and fulfillment roles, while Reborn Coffee is included only as a micro-cap speculative customer example showing how franchise expansion can depend on outsourced distribution readiness.
